signals.title: Microsoft's Project Zenith: Windows dev PCs that run 30B+ param models locally, unmetered
signals.summary: Microsoft is shipping a preconfigured 'ready-to-code' Windows 11 experience for developer-class hardware (Ryzen AI Halo, 64GB+ unified memory) that runs 30B+ parameter models locally with zero token metering, plus a policy layer (MXC) for scoping what agents can touch.
signals.run_with_it_note: Before spending on the hardware: run one recurring token-heavy task (support email triage, or a boatcam transcript pass) through a local model on existing Mac hardware this week and clock the cost/quality delta. If local holds up, a Zenith-class box is the graduate move, not the first one.

signals.title: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 undercuts OpenAI, Google, and ElevenLabs on transcription price and speed
signals.summary: New Microsoft speech-recognition model claims the fastest, cheapest, most accurate transcription available, undercutting OpenAI/Google/ElevenLabs on price with multilingual support (corroborated separately by VentureBeat).
signals.run_with_it_note: Run one existing boatcam clip or a recorded customer call through it this week and compare price + word-error-rate against whatever currently generates captions/transcripts. Direct lever for the boatcam pipeline and for turning Twilio call recordings into searchable text cheaply.

signals.title: Local-first, vendor-independent memory for AI coding agents (Engrim + Funes, same week)
signals.summary: Two independent projects landed the same week pushing agent memory local and owned instead of vendor-hosted: Engrim (Show HN, 52 pts, universal SQLite memory engine for AI CLIs) and Hugging Face's Funes (lets coding agents keep session history across machines you control). Corroborates a real 'own your agent's memory' pattern forming, not a one-off.
signals.run_with_it_note: Free and open-source. Install Engrim this week and point one recurring build task at it (e.g. a specific business's content pipeline) to see if a local memory file actually survives across sessions without re-explaining context, as a portable complement to the existing Claude memory system.

signals.title: GPT-6 Astra ships — first model to trip OpenAI's critical-cyber safeguard threshold
signals.summary: OpenAI's flagship is now actually out (last week was only leaked/teased outputs). Reaches exceptional scores on ARC-AGI-3 via symbolic world-model reasoning, and is the first release to cross OpenAI's own critical-cybersecurity capability line. Densest 72 hours of frontier launches this year: Astra, Claude Fable 5.1 (cache pricing -75%), Gemini 3.8 Flash, Meta Muse Spark 1.3.

signals.title: "How to build a one-person company that runs from Slack"
signals.summary: Founder playbook thread on running a solo company through an AI assistant wired into shared context, tools, and explicit approval checkpoints inside chat, functionally the same shape as David's own chief-of-staff/kid-coach approval loops.

signals.title: YC S26: industrial/hardware companies triple to 23% of the batch, SaaS drops to 12%
signals.summary: Data-driven read on YC's latest batch: physical/industrial startups tripled to 23% of the cohort (historical average ~7-8%), SaaS collapsed to 12%. Corroborated by this week's robotics/physical-agent Launch HNs (Nori Robotics humanoid, Hebbian Robotics data pipelines, Mireye physical-world agent infra).

signals.title: Chinese businesses bundle AI tokens as loyalty perks (with coffee, credit cards, dumplings)
signals.summary: AI compute is now cheap enough in China that businesses give tokens away as a loyalty freebie alongside coffee and credit cards. A faint leading indicator for where global token pricing is headed, not yet visible in US press.

signals.title: Nvidia Personal AI Router (PAIR)
signals.summary: Nvidia platform for routing workflows across local AI systems on RTX hardware. Single-source this week, thin coverage so far.

signals.title: GitHub's Project HydraFusion: auto-picks the best model per coding task across providers
signals.summary: Copilot orchestration layer that routes each dev task to whichever frontier model handles it best. Single-source this week.
